description: One data point per HTTP request, from the access line emitted by the RequestLog plugin (#805). Labelled by matched route pattern, method and status, which is what makes per-endpoint volume and error rate answerable at all -- Cloud Run's own request_count metric has NO path label, so it can say 'the service returned 40 5xx' but never which endpoint.

labels.description: Matched route PATTERN, e.g. /api/v1/matches/{id}. Never a concrete path -- raw URIs would make this label unbounded. Unrouted traffic collapses into '(unmatched)'.
